passage:
The call came while Urmila was making tea. "Ma'am, this is your bank, and your account is frozen unless you confirm the code in ten minutes." The caller even knew her name. Her chest tightened, but something felt wrong; she hung up, dialled the number printed on her card and was told the bank had made no such call.

Joseph was not so lucky. Three weeks before, he had paid a "registration fee" for a job offer and lost most of his internship savings. He told nobody because he could already hear the jokes. It was Urmila who found him at the canteen with his phone face down and asked, "You look awful. What happened?" Joseph talked, and within an hour they were at the cyber cell counter with screenshots.

On the way, Joseph was seething. "I'm going to message this guy from another number and trap him myself," he said. Urmila shook her head. "Give the police what you have. Chasing him alone could cost you more."

That evening Yusuf sent the group a link. "Guaranteed profit, doubles in a week, my uncle's friend made a lot." Urmila did not forward it. She wrote back, "Where did you get this? Show me who runs it," and added a heart so he would know she still liked him.

qa.q: What did Urmila do after the caller said her account would be frozen?
qa.a: She hung up, dialled the number printed on her card, and learned the bank had not called.

qa.q: How did Joseph's silence and Urmila's quick call lead to different outcomes?
qa.a: Urmila paused and checked through an official number, so she lost nothing. Joseph stayed silent out of fear of jokes and lost savings, until speaking up got him to the cyber cell.

qa.q: What was Joseph feeling when he wanted to trap the scammer himself?
qa.a: He was furious and wanted revenge, though that plan could bring more loss.

qa.q: How could Urmila respond to Yusuf so that the friendship stays but the scheme does not spread?
qa.a: She can question him calmly about the source, refuse to forward it, and show him warmly that she is not judging him, which is what she did.

grounding: One friend group meets a scam through a spoofed call, a hidden loss, an angry urge to retaliate and a friend forwarding a too-good scheme.
